en.Situation: In my first SOC role I took the overnight shift, and one alert type fired about eighty times a night for the same service account.
en.Task: My task was to triage fast enough to catch a real incident, without dismissing the noisy alert as harmless.
en.Action: I grouped the alerts by account and source address, found the pattern came from a backup script, and wrote a tuning request with the evidence.
en.Result: The tuning cut the queue by about seventy per cent, and the next real alert was picked up inside four minutes.
en.vague: The alerts were noisy on the night shift and it was tiring.
en.exaggerated: I redesigned the whole monitoring platform on my own.
en.no_data: After the tuning the queue was much smaller.

zh.Situation: 第一份 SOC 工作我上通宵更，同一類 alert 每晚為同一個 service account 響大約八十次。
zh.Task: 我要 triage 快到捉到真 incident，同時唔可以當個嘈 alert 冇事。
zh.Action: 我按 account 同來源位址分組，發現係 backup script 引起，再連證據寫 tuning request。
zh.Result: tuning 令 queue 減大約七成，下一個真 alert 四分鐘內有人接手。
zh.vague: 通宵更啲 alert 好嘈，都幾累。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人重新設計咗成個監控平台。
zh.no_data: tuning 之後 queue 細咗好多。

en.Situation: At a bank, a manager forwarded a phishing email that asked staff to confirm their password on a page that looked like ours.
en.Task: I was on the mailbox team, and I had to find out who had already clicked before anyone replied to the email.
en.Action: I checked the mail gateway log for the link, listed the six recipients who clicked, and had their sessions reset within the hour.
en.Result: Two accounts had already been tried, both were blocked at login, and the timeline went into the incident report.
en.vague: There was a phishing email and we looked into it.
en.exaggerated: I stopped a full bank breach by myself that morning.
en.no_data: In the end the accounts were reset and nothing was lost.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，有位主管轉發一封釣魚電郵，叫同事喺同我們相似嘅頁面確認密碼。
zh.Task: 我喺 mail gateway 組，要喺有人回覆之前查出邊個已經點過。
zh.Action: 我喺 gateway log 查條連結，列出六位點過嘅收件人，一小時內重置佢哋 session。
zh.Result: 兩個帳戶曾被人試登入，兩次都喺登入被擋，時間線亦寫入 incident report。
zh.vague: 有封釣魚電郵，我哋去查。
zh.exaggerated: 我嗰朝一個人阻止咗全銀行外洩。

en.Situation: A vulnerability scan reported forty critical findings on one subnet, and the system owner refused to look at them.
en.Task: I had to separate the real risk from the noise before escalating, or the escalation would be ignored.
en.Action: I checked ten findings by hand, found eight were scanner assumptions about an unused service, and re-scanned with credentials.
en.Result: The list came down to six real findings, and the owner fixed four in the same week.
en.vague: The scan produced a lot of findings and nobody acted on them.
en.exaggerated: I closed every vulnerability in that subnet.
en.no_data: After checking, the list was shorter and some were fixed.

zh.Situation: 一次漏洞掃描喺一個 subnet 報咗四十個 critical，而系統 owner 拒絕睇。
zh.Task: 我要喺升級之前分開真風險同噪音，否則升級都會被無視。
zh.Action: 我逐個手查十個發現，其中八個係 scanner 對一個未用服務嘅假設，再改用有憑證嘅方式重掃。
zh.Result: 清單收窄到六個真發現，owner 同一星期修好四個。
zh.vague: 掃描出咗好多發現，但冇人跟。
zh.exaggerated: 我關閉咗該 subnet 所有漏洞。
zh.no_data: 查完之後清單短咗，有啲亦修好。

en.Situation: Four years in, I had to tell a department head that his team's shared account was the cause of an incident, without turning it into a blame session.
en.Task: I needed one behaviour change from his team, agreed the same day.
en.Action: I described what the shared account made impossible to prove, offered a named-account alternative, and let him choose the rollout week.
en.Result: The shared account was retired in three weeks, and he asked for the same review in another team.
en.vague: There was an incident and a shared account was involved.
en.exaggerated: I forced a whole department to change their working practice.
en.no_data: In the end the shared account was removed.

zh.Situation: 做咗四年，我要同一位部門主管講，佢團隊嘅共用帳戶係一次 incident 嘅原因，但唔可以變成追究大會。
zh.Task: 我要佢團隊改一個做法，而且當日就議定。
zh.Action: 我講清楚共用帳戶令邊啲事證明唔到，提供有名字帳戶嘅替代方案，再讓佢揀推行那一星期。
zh.Result: 共用帳戶三星期內退役，佢仲叫另一個團隊做同樣檢視。
zh.vague: 有次 incident 牽涉一個共用帳戶。
zh.exaggerated: 我逼到整個部門改變工作方式。

en.Situation: In my internship, a developer asked me to test a firewall change directly on production because the lab copy was slow.
en.Task: I had to help without approving something I had no authority or evidence for.
en.Action: I asked for the change to go through the normal request, tested it on the lab copy, and sent him the result the same afternoon.
en.Result: The lab test found one rule that blocked our own monitoring, and production went ahead the next day with the fix.
en.vague: There was a request to test something on production.
en.exaggerated: I stopped the company from making a serious mistake.
en.no_data: In the end the change went through the proper path.

zh.Situation: 實習時有位開發同事叫我直接喺 production 測一個 firewall 改動，因為 lab 副本慢。
zh.Task: 我要幫手，但唔可以批一啲我無權、亦冇證據支持嘅事。
zh.Action: 我請佢行正常申請流程，我先喺 lab 副本測，當日下午交結果畀佢。
zh.Result: lab 測試發現有一條規則會擋住自家監控，第二日 production 帶住修正推行。
zh.vague: 有人要求喺 production 測嘢。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗公司犯一個嚴重錯誤。
zh.no_data: 最後改動行走正常流程。

en.Situation: Before an ISO 27001 audit, we had evidence for eight of eleven controls and two weeks to close the gap.
en.Task: I was asked to gather what existed, and to say plainly which controls we could not evidence.
en.Action: I built one folder per control, wrote a one-line status for each, and put the three weak ones at the top of the weekly note.
en.Result: The auditor accepted eight controls outright and raised two minor findings, which was fewer than we expected.
en.vague: The audit needed evidence and some of it was missing.
en.exaggerated: I made the company fully ISO 27001 compliant.
en.no_data: In the end the audit closed with fewer findings than expected.

zh.Situation: ISO 27001 審計前，十一個控制項我哋只有八個有證據，而只剩兩星期。
zh.Task: 有人叫我收集現有嘅，並老實講邊幾個控制項冇證據。
zh.Action: 我為每個控制項開一個 folder，每個寫一行狀態，再把三個弱項放喺每週備註最前面。
zh.Result: 審計員直接接受八個，另外只提兩個 minor finding，比我哋預期少。
zh.vague: 審計要證據，而有啲唔見咗。
zh.exaggerated: 我令公司完全符合 ISO 27001。
zh.no_data: 最後審計 finding 比預期少。

en.Situation: Five years in, a login anomaly alert fired for a service account at three in the morning and the on-call engineer escalated straight to me.
en.Task: I had to decide within the hour whether this was an intrusion or a scheduled job.
en.Action: I pulled the process list at that timestamp, matched it to a change ticket raised the previous day, and confirmed it with the owning team.
en.Result: It was a scheduled migration, and the alert was tuned with the ticket id as a reference.
en.vague: An alert fired at night and I had to check it.
en.exaggerated: I prevented a serious intrusion at three in the morning.
en.no_data: In the end it was not an intrusion.

zh.Situation: 做咗五年，凌晨三點一個 service account 觸發登入異常 alert，on-call 直接升級畀我。
zh.Task: 我要喺一小時內判斷係入侵定排程工作。
zh.Action: 我抽該時間點嘅 process list，對上前一日開嘅 change ticket，再同負責團隊確認。
zh.Result: 係排程遷移，alert 之後以 ticket id 作參考做 tuning。
zh.exaggerated: 我凌晨三點阻止咗一次嚴重入侵。

en.Situation: In my first job, an access review asked us to list every account with database write permission.
en.Task: I had to produce the list from the systems rather than from memory.
en.Action: I wrote a query per system, joined the results into one table with owner and last login, and marked the four accounts with no owner.
en.Result: Two of the four belonged to leavers and were disabled that week, and the review became a quarterly script.
en.vague: We needed a list of accounts for a review.
en.exaggerated: I removed all excessive permissions in the company.
en.no_data: After the review, a few accounts were disabled.

zh.Situation: 第一份工，一次權限檢視要我哋列出所有有資料庫寫入權限嘅帳戶。
zh.Task: 我要由系統產生清單，而唔係憑記憶。
zh.Action: 我為每個系統寫 query，把結果 join 成一張表連 owner 同最後登入，再標出四個冇 owner 嘅帳戶。
zh.Result: 其中兩個屬於已離職同事，同一星期已停用，而檢視變成一季一次嘅 script。
zh.exaggerated: 我清除咗公司所有過大權限。
zh.no_data: 檢視之後有幾個帳戶被停用。

en.Situation: At a bank, three teams wanted to skip the change approval for a firewall rule because the release was that evening.
en.Task: I was the reviewer, and I had to refuse without being the person who blocked the release for no reason.
en.Action: I offered to review within thirty minutes if they sent the rule and the rollback plan, and I reviewed two of the three that way.
en.Result: Two rules went out that evening after review, and the third was wrong in a way the review caught.
en.vague: People wanted to skip approval for a change.
en.exaggerated: I enforced every rule in the change process single-handedly.
en.no_data: In the end two changes went out after review.

zh.Situation: 喺銀行，三個團隊因為當晚發佈，想跳過 firewall 改動嘅審批。
zh.Task: 我係審批人，要拒絕，但唔想成為無理阻住發佈嘅人。
zh.Action: 我提出如果佢哋交規則同 rollback 計劃，我三十分鐘內審，結果用呢個方式審咗三個之中兩個。
zh.Result: 兩個規則當晚審完出街，第三個被審出嚟係錯嘅。
zh.exaggerated: 我一個人執行晒改動流程每條規則。
zh.no_data: 最後兩個改動審完出咗。

en.Situation: Six years in, our team ran a tabletop exercise for a ransomware scenario and the first answer from operations was to switch everything off.
en.Task: I had to turn that into a plan with steps, owners and a decision point, in two hours.
en.Action: I drew the timeline on a whiteboard, marked where the decision was missing, and wrote the four steps the team could actually do.
en.Result: The second exercise ran in half the time, and the operations lead brought the plan to the next management meeting.
en.vague: We did an exercise about a ransomware scenario.
en.exaggerated: I wrote the company's complete incident response plan.

zh.Situation: 做咗六年，團隊做勒索軟件情境演練，營運第一位答「全部關掉」。
zh.Task: 我要喺兩小時內把它變成有步驟、負責人同決策點嘅計劃。
zh.Action: 我在白板畫時間線，標出邊度缺決策，再寫出團隊實際做得到嘅四步。
zh.Result: 第二次演練用一半時間完成，營運主管仲把計劃帶去管理層會議。
zh.vague: 我哋做咗個勒索軟件演練。
zh.exaggerated: 我寫咗公司完整嘅事故應變計劃。

en.Situation: On a six-month contract, I was asked to check whether a contractor really needed admin rights on a file server.
en.Task: I had to answer with evidence and not with a policy quote.
en.Action: I looked at the access log for four weeks, found the account used two folders and never changed permissions, and wrote that up.
en.Result: The contractor kept access to those two folders and lost admin rights, and the work did not stop.
en.vague: Someone asked whether a contractor needed admin rights.
en.exaggerated: I removed all unnecessary admin rights in the company.
en.no_data: In the end the access was reduced and the work continued.

zh.Situation: 做半年合約，有人叫我查一位承辦商同事是否真需要檔案伺服器 admin 權限。
zh.Task: 我要用證據回答，而唔係引用政策。
zh.Action: 我睇四星期 access log，發現個帳戶只用兩個 folder、從來冇改權限，於是寫成報告。
zh.Result: 承辦商保留該兩個 folder 嘅權限但失去 admin，工作冇停過。
zh.vague: 有人問承辦商要唔要 admin 權限。
zh.exaggerated: 我清除咗公司所有不必要 admin 權限。
zh.no_data: 最後權限縮減，工作繼續。

en.Situation: A colleague pasted a customer list into a shared chat to speed up an investigation, and the file stayed there for a week.
en.Task: I had to raise it without making him a cautionary tale in front of the team.
en.Action: I spoke to him first, showed the retention rule, and suggested the ticket attachment we already had.
en.Result: He deleted the file and posted the rule himself in the team channel the next day.
en.vague: A file was shared in a chat channel.
en.exaggerated: I prevented a serious data protection breach.
en.no_data: In the end the file was removed and the rule was shared.

zh.Situation: 有位同事為加快調查，把客戶名單貼入共用 chat，個檔案留咗一個星期。
zh.Task: 我要提出問題，但唔想令佢喺團隊面前變成反面教材。
zh.Action: 我先私下同佢講，展示保留規則，再建議用我哋本來已有嘅 ticket 附件。
zh.Result: 佢刪咗個檔案，第二日仲自己喺團隊頻道貼出規則。
zh.vague: 有個檔案喺 chat 分享咗。
zh.exaggerated: 我阻止咗一次嚴重資料保護外洩。
zh.no_data: 最後檔案移除，規則亦有分享。
